technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for rapid configuration and service discovery integration.
Leverage Docker Compose for local development and testing of container configurations.
Implement CI pipeline using Jenkins or GitHub Actions for Docker image builds.
Use Spring Cloud for service discovery mechanisms (e.g., Eureka, Consul).
Integrate HDFS source module using Spring Data and Hadoop components.
Configure commit-interval override via servers.yml for OOTB jobs.
Document Mesos and Marathon deployment using standard architectural patterns.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Boot and Docker.
Existing CI infrastructure is available for Docker image builds.
Service discovery tools like Eureka or Consul are already in use or planned.
HDFS cluster is accessible for testing the HDFS source module.
Mesos and Marathon environments are available for deployment testing.
All external services (Rabbit, Redis, etc.) have Docker images available.

activities.activity_name: Configure Docker XD Containers for External Services
activities.activity_description: Implement configuration options for linking Docker XD containers to external services like Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, and Mongo, including environment variables and binding attributes.

activities.activity_name: Implement Service Discovery for Docker XD Containers
activities.activity_description: Integrate service discovery mechanisms to allow processes and services in a cluster to find and communicate with each other.

activities.activity_name: Create Docker Images via CI Build
activities.activity_description: Set up CI pipeline to build Docker images containing all components and configurations, enabling testing and deployment across environments.

activities.activity_name: Document XD Cluster Deployment on Mesos with Marathon
activities.activity_description: Produce documentation outlining recommendations for deploying an XD cluster using Apache Mesos and the Marathon framework.
Assess impact of Spring Boot dependency upgrades on existing functionality to ensure no side effects.

activities.activity_name: Implement Data Partitioning Strategy for RDBMS to HDFS
activities.activity_description: Add option to supply a data partitioning strategy to parallelize data ingestion from RDBMS to HDFS.
Develop an HDFS source module to enable direct data ingestion from the Hadoop Distributed File System.
Allow users to override the default commit-interval for all out-of-the-box jobs with partition support via the servers.yml configuration file.
